description: Linux sysctl hardening audit — Audit Linux kernel settings offline: send text= with /etc/sysctl.conf, a sysctl.d file or full sysctl -a output (role=host|router|container-host, default host). Checks about 40 CIS / Kernel Self-Protection settings: ASLR, kptr_restrict, ptrace scope, unprivileged eBPF and userfaultfd, suid core dumps, protected symlinks/hardlinks, mmap_min_addr, IP forwarding, ICMP redirects, source routing, rp_filter, SYN cookies, router advertisements, suspicious core_pattern pipes and duplicates. Returns PASS / REVIEW / FIX BEFORE DEPLOY / BLOCK, score and grade, findings with fixes, settings not set in the file, and a ready hardened sysctl.d file. Example: /v1/security/sysctl-check?text=kernel.randomize_va_space%3D1 Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_sysctl_check
